Joice, your profile is very interesting. Were you a teacher before?
Twenty-five years! Was your first school in São Paulo?
Yes, it was. It was a small public school in the east of the city.
How many teachers were there?
There were only twelve teachers, and four hundred students.
That was difficult. And was it a good experience?
It was difficult, and it was the best school of my career.
And the INSTI conference in 2023. Was that your first event abroad?
Yes. It was my first, and the sessions were all in English.
Before this, I worked in a public school.
It was difficult, and it was very good.
That was twenty-five years ago.
I have a lot of experience with public schools.

Hello, and thank you for sending your profile. Here is a short summary for the program. You were a school director for twenty-five years, and your first school was a small public school in the east of São Paulo. There were four hundred students and only twelve teachers. In 2023 you were at the INSTI conference, and that was your first international event. Last year you were part of the Meteoro Program. If something here is not correct, please write to me before Friday. Thank you.

Hi, this is a short message about last week. The meeting was on Tuesday, not on Monday, and it was only thirty minutes. Two people were not there, because they were at the conference in Recife. The report was ready, but the data about small schools was not complete. It was not a problem: we were all in agreement about the next step. The next meeting is in two weeks. Thank you very much.

Joice reads the profile of the event program on her computer. She sees that the text about her first school is correct. She remembers the twelve teachers of that school. She writes one small correction about the year. She sends the profile back before Friday.
